claim.text: Formula Atlas Run 10 records CUMIPMT and CUMPRINC with Microsoft's six required arguments, cumulative interest/principal meanings, payment timing, positive-input and period/type constraints, and all four published example results rounded as displayed. source.excerpt: Microsoft documents CUMIPMT and CUMPRINC as cumulative loan interest and principal over a payment-period range, with six required arguments, type 0/1 timing, positive rate/nper/pv, period ordering, and examples.
